best_lineage.idea: Replace the naive recursive merge sort with an iterative bottom-up merge sort (with insertion sort for small runs and an already-sorted shortcut), which dramatically cuts recursion overhead and merge cost on nearly-sorted inputs and avoids per-call large allocations for small n, raising throughput especially on the uniform, dups and nearly_sorted distributions.
